allow: Shell(echo "NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV"; npm config get omit; npm config get production; echo "--- .npmrc files ---"; cat .npmrc 2>/dev/null; cat ~/.npmrc 2>/dev/null; echo "--- npm ls depth 0 ---"; npm ls --depth=0 2>&1 | head -40)

Shell(grep -rn "NODE_ENV" ~/.zshenv /etc/zshenv /etc/zshrc /etc/zprofile ~/.config/zsh 2>/dev/null; echo "--- sourced files ---"; zsh -ic 'zcurses 2>/dev/null; source ~/.zshrc 2>/dev/null'; grep -rn "NODE_ENV" ~/.oh-my-zsh/custom 2>/dev/null | head)
Shell(git check-ignore -v build content/scripts/zotero-ner-bundled.js 2>&1; echo "--- tracked? ---"; git ls-files content/scripts/ | head)

Shell(echo "local main: $(git rev-parse main)"; echo "remote main: $(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)"; echo "=== tag type ==="; git cat-file -t v1.5.1; git cat-file -t v1.5.0; echo "=== tag targets ==="; git rev-parse v1.5.1^{commit} 2>&1; echo "=== push config ==="; git config --get-regexp 'push\.' ; echo "=== hooks ==="; ls .git/hooks | grep -v sample)

Shell(XPI=$(ls build/*.xpi); COMPUTED=$(openssl dgst -sha512 "$XPI" | awk '{print $NF}'); DECLARED=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('update.json','utf8')).addons['zotero-name-normalizer@marcinmilkowski.pl'].updates[0].update_hash.replace('sha512:','')"); echo "declared: $DECLARED"; echo "computed: $COMPUTED"; [ "$COMPUTED" = "$DECLARED" ] && echo "MATCH" || echo "MISMATCH")

Shell(echo "HEAD after: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; echo "tags after: $(git tag -l 'v1.5*' | tr '\n' ' ')"; echo "clean? (excluding known build/dev churn)"; git status --short; echo "=== release artifacts ==="; ls build/*.xpi build/update.json)

Shell(echo "=== git state ==="; git log --oneline -3; git status --short; echo "=== local update.json hash/version ==="; node -p "const u=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('update.json','utf8')).addons['zotero-name-normalizer@marcinmilkowski.pl'].updates[0]; u.version+' '+u.update_hash+'\n'+u.update_link"; echo "=== local build xpi ==="; ls -l build/*.xpi 2>/dev/null; openssl dgst -sha512 build/*.xpi 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}')
